_comment: Settings for the GulfCoastMesh Mobile option, sent to the device's CLI after a flash. Run in order; a leading underscore parks a note or a command without deleting it.
_name_prefix: Prepended to the name the user types before it is written to the device: 'Bob's House' becomes 'al-Bob's House'. Advertised names are capped at 23 bytes when location is included, which a repeater always is, so the prefix spends part of that budget.
_units: advert.interval: minutes (60-240). flood.advert.interval: hours (3-168). agc.reset.interval: seconds, rounded down to a multiple of 4. Both intervals take 0 to disable.
_radio: Sets freq/bw/sf/cr together, COMMA-separated -- spaces parse as one field and the command is rejected. Out-of-range is rejected, not clamped. Needs a reboot, which the flasher sends itself after the list.
_regions: def walks a cursor from the wildcard *: a bare token creates a child and moves onto it, 'name|jump' creates a child then jumps elsewhere. Cursor resets to * per command. 160 chars max per line.
_firmware_commands: if_mod selects then/else commands using metadata captured from the Enhanced MeshCore+ application at flash time. Stock firmware uses else. Sync builds seed and save the overlay without enabling reception; native region def * does not erase preserved named entries.
_regions_tree: Either def branch builds: us > (us-gc, us-southeast, us-south, us-east, us-al, us-ms, us-fl); us-al > (us-al-mob, us-al-fhp, us-al-guf); us-fl > us-fl-pns. Both command variants fit the 160-byte CLI buffer. Provisional -- the naming convention is not settled.
_regions_notes: Sync firmware saves the independent overlay; other firmware seeds native regions. Native def merges rather than replacing existing entries, and def * alone does not clear them. Both branches preserve local entries on upgrades. region allowf * enables unscoped flooding; region save persists native state.

then: sync.region def us us-gc|us us-southeast|us us-south|us us-east|us us-al us-al-mob|us-al us-al-fhp|us-al us-al-guf|us us-ms|us us-fl us-fl-pns
else: region def us us-gc|us us-southeast|us us-south|us us-east|us us-al us-al-mob|us-al us-al-fhp|us-al us-al-guf|us us-ms|us us-fl us-fl-pns
